about: Where the four load cells sit under the deck, and how to turn their volts into newtons.
Positions are measured on the top surface from the deck's FRONT-LEFT corner (seen from above,
facing forward on the belt): x_m to the right, y_m toward the back, in metres, to the centre
WIRING: load cell N plugs into the amplifier's load-cell input N (M12 connectors 1-4 on the
Michigan Scientific SGA12), so signals NX, NY, NZ come out on wire bundle N. Plug them in
SCALE: newtons_per_volt is per axis, from each load cell's calibration sheet. The amplifier
has gain 201 and 10 V excitation, so a sheet giving S mV/V at a rated load of F newtons means
newtons_per_volt = F / (2.01 * S). Flip the sign of Z if pressing down reads negative: the
GUI wants a load pressing down on the deck to be positive Z.
Set scale_is_placeholder to false once the real numbers are in.
